title: Table 1 Events V1 client contract
description: Every call the iOS, Android and web clients make. Field names are exact wire names (snake_case). Generate Swift/Kotlin models from this file; the hand-written models in apps/ must stay in step with it.

set_event_location.note: Organizer only. Stores the event point (never readable by clients). visibility=nearby sends nearby alerts once.

nearby_events.note: Coordinates are used for this query only.

joined.description: The caller is already an active player in this event or organizes it.

get_join_qr.note: Organizer only. QR payload is url = https://table-1.site/j/<short_code>?s=<secret>. p_rotate invalidates earlier codes.

invite_to_event.note: Organizer only. Same rules as invite_players (setup/seated events only).

update_presence.note: Stores only a geohash-6 cell (~1 km) for opt-in nearby alerts.

report_match.note: Signed-in player. Counts immediately. Opponent entering the same score confirms; a different score disputes (first result stands). Retries with the same idempotency key return the first answer.

set_match_result.note: Organizer only; final, audited with reason, records apply the difference.

p_env.description: APNs environment of the token (Debug builds: development). Default production.

is_event_organizer.note: True when the signed-in account is an owner/organizer of the event. Picks the organizer vs player screen.

events_home.note: Everything the Events tab shows. p_include_demo is true only in TestFlight/Xcode iOS builds.

account_overview.note: Profile, lifetime record and head-to-head computed from match_outcomes. p_include_demo as events_home.

cancel_event.note: Organizer only; setup/seated/in_progress. Closes the open round (reported results confirm), ends Live Activities, refuses joins.

suggested_players.note: Organizer only. Co-participants of the caller's events, most shared first; excludes people already seated.

invite_players.note: Organizer only; setup/seated. Up to 50 per call, 100 per hour. Sends invitations (owner_invite).

invite_by_email.note: Organizer only; setup/seated. Existing accounts only, no email sent, same answer either way. 20 lookups per hour.

demo_seed.note: Replaces the caller's demo data (TestFlight only in the apps): 12 sample opponents, 9 events in every state.

demo_remove.note: Removes the caller's demo data. Also run by delete_account.

create_event_v2.note: Typed formats. Limited events may name a set (from draftable_sets) or a cube; team formats need p_team_size 3|4. 2026-10-14: name is automatic (p_name ignored), rounds always 3000 s (p_round_seconds ignored); p_include_me seats the organizer first; p_show_clock hides clocks; p_local_date names the day. 2026-10-16: format roto (cube required, set refused); p_pairing swiss|round_robin (round_robin roto only; roto defaults to round_robin).

p_pairing.description: Roto only may be round_robin (default for roto when null). Other formats are always swiss.

draftable_sets.note: Scryfall sets for limited events, newest first. anon + authenticated.

p_token.description: A web guest's claim token (lib/session.ts). Organizers and players leave it out.

errors.42501: That event isn't available (not organizer, player or guest)

set_teams.note: Organizer, before round 1. Member order is slot order (1 = seat A). Team draft: max 2 teams.

tracker_open.note: The two players of a match (organizer read-only). Creates the shared session on first open.

my_side.description: 0/1 for a player; 0 for the organizer when keeper; null = watching (read-only).

clock.description: The match's round timer; null when the match has no round. Running: remaining = timer_remaining_at_change - (now - timer_last_started_at), negative in overtime. Paused: remaining = timer_remaining_at_change (null means timer_duration_seconds).

keeper.description: Organizer keeping score for a match with no accounts (guests only): my_side is 0 and the result is reported with set_match_result.

tracker_push.note: Up to 200 ops; idempotent by client_op_id; ops for recorded games are ignored.

update_event_details.note: Organizer only, setup/seated with no rounds (else 55000 'Details lock once round 1 is paired'). Send the full current state every call. Non-team format releases everyone from teams. 2026-10-14: p_show_clock (null keeps); p_round_seconds ignored; p_name ignored for auto-named events. 2026-10-16: roto + p_pairing (null keeps); format and cube lock once the roto draft starts (55000). Result carries pairing.

p_pairing.description: Roto only may be round_robin (default for roto when null). Other formats are always swiss.

set_round_clock.note: Organizer only, active round. pause | resume | add (p_seconds, default 300). Keeps timer_ends_at / timer_last_started_at / timer_remaining_at_change consistent; drives Live Activity clock pushes.

search_cards.note: Card name typeahead over Oracle cards (contract/catalog-2026-10-14.md). Needs >= 2 normalized characters; prefix matches first, then fuzzy. anon + authenticated.

card_printings.note: All paper printings of one card, newest first, with USD/EUR prices. anon + authenticated.

catalog_info.note: Latest catalog pack; null before the first sync. Download url only when version changes (contract/catalog-2026-10-14.md). anon + authenticated.

collection_apply.note: The one collection write (contract/collection-2026-10-15.md). Ops set qty or add delta; whole batch rejected on any error. Same p_idempotency_key replays return duplicate:true. binder_id (with delta only): added copies go into that binder, removed copies come out of it first; allocations an item can no longer cover shrink Unsorted first, then binders not for trade, then for-trade binders (contract/binders-wants-2026-10-17.md). authenticated.

items.description: [binder_id, card_id, finish, condition, lang, qty, seq]; qty 0 = gone

collection_undo.note: Reverses one earlier batch, once: items, the binder allocations it changed, and wants a trade met. Binder deletions and wishlist batches can't be undone. authenticated.

[oracle_id, card_id|null, finish|null, qty, max_usd|null, seq]; qty 0 = gone

collection_changes.note: Delta sync by seq. items are compact arrays [card_id, finish, condition, lang, qty, seq]; qty 0 = deleted. Page while more; resync:true = clear local copy and restart from 0. authenticated.

library_summary_get.note: Library top-level numbers (one row read). authenticated.

collection_card_history.note: One printing's ledger, newest first. authenticated.

seat_event.note: Organizer only; draft/team_draft before round 1 (status setup/seated). One transaction: random seats in pods of up to 8 (team draft: one pod, A1 B1 A2 B2). Calling again re-shuffles. Errors 42501 not organizer, 55000 locked/not a draft/team problems, 22023 no players. Replaces events-engine seat_players (2026-10-14). 2026-10-16: roto too (always one pod); 55000 once the roto draft has started.

list_create.note: Creates a deck or cube (client-chosen id; idempotent). contract/lists-2026-10-15.md. authenticated.

list_edit.note: Applies edit ops (each with an optional finish and lang; to_card_id/to_finish/to_lang moves copies to another printing, finish or language); groups edits within 10 minutes into one version. contract/lists-2026-10-15.md. authenticated.

list_restore.note: Appends a copy of an old version. contract/lists-2026-10-15.md. authenticated.

list_update.note: Renames or changes format. contract/lists-2026-10-15.md. authenticated.

list_delete.note: Deletes for every device (tombstone in lists_changes). contract/lists-2026-10-15.md. authenticated.

lists_changes.note: Delta sync of lists by seq. contract/lists-2026-10-15.md. authenticated.

add_guest.note: Organizer only; before round 1. A player by name only (claim token created). 1-40 chars; 23505 duplicate name.

add_self_to_event.note: Organizer only; before round 1. The organizer joins their own event. 23505 already playing.

remove_participant.note: Organizer only; before round 1 (55000 after; use Drop). Seated drafts: later seats in the pod move up one. Withdraws a pending invite.

recent_cubes.note: This account's recent cubes, newest first.

scan_report.note: Records a scan the user corrected by what they did (deleted it, changed its printing, or added a card by hand after a deletion or a miss) as a matcher test case (contract/trades-2026-10-16.md, Scanning). Text only. removed: no corrected card; missed: no matched card; the rest need both. At most 12 frames of 80 lines; 200 reports a day per account. Not sent when the device's Improve scanning switch is off. authenticated.

p_frames.description: OCR lines of the last frames before the take, oldest first, top of frame first

unregister_device.description: Sign-out: the token stops reaching this account.

roto_state.note: Players and organizers of the event (42501 otherwise). The one read for a roto: config, seats in pick order, who is on the clock, picks after p_after_pick, the pool (first load), and the caller's list. Unix seconds throughout. Epoch fields null until set.

pool.description: [slot, card_id, finish]; sent when p_pool, or by default when p_after_pick = 0

roto_set_cube.note: Organizer, before start. One of the caller's own Library cubes (Main board is the pool). Sets the event's cube_name to the list name. Errors 42501, 22023 not a roto / empty cube, 55000 started, P0002 not your cube.

roto_start.note: Organizer. Seats everyone (one pod, random) unless already cleanly seated, snapshots the cube, creates each account's linked deck, starts the clock if set. Locks players and seats. 22023 too many picks for the cube / under 2 players, 55000 already started / no cube.

roto_set_clock.note: Organizer, until the last pick. p_clock null keeps the schedule; [] or JSON null clears it. 1–10 ranges, first from_round 1, 30–86400 s. The current turn keeps its time (an untimed turn starts timing now). p_paused true/false pauses/resumes (resume keeps the remaining time). Returns state without picks.

picks.description: [pick_no, seat, slot, how (player|auto|timeout|organizer), at (epoch s)], only picks after p_after_pick

pool.description: [slot, card_id, finish]; sent when p_pool, or by default when p_after_pick = 0

roto_undo.note: Organizer, before round 1 is paired. Removes the last pick a person made (player or organizer) and every auto/timeout pick after it; decks follow. Runs no auto-picks afterwards. Returns state at the new picks_made (clients drop picks above it).

picks.description: [pick_no, seat, slot, how (player|auto|timeout|organizer), at (epoch s)], only picks after p_after_pick

roto_pick.note: The player on the clock, or an organizer (recorded as an organizer pick). p_pick_no must be picks_made + 1, else {ok:false, conflict:true, state} and nothing changes. Then auto-picks run for following players. Errors 42501 not your pick, 22023 unknown slot, 23505 already picked, 55000 not started/over.

picks.description: [pick_no, seat, slot, how (player|auto|timeout|organizer), at (epoch s)], only picks after p_after_pick

roto_queue_set.note: The caller's private pick list, replaced whole (debounce on the client). Taken/unknown slots dropped, duplicates keep their first place, max 1000. p_auto_pick null keeps the switch (default on). Can pick at once if the caller is on the clock (auto-pick, or an overdue turn).

roto_expire.note: Anyone in the event, when their countdown reaches zero (pg_cron also sweeps every minute). Past the deadline: takes the first available card on the on-clock player's list (how = timeout); with nothing listed the turn stays overdue. No-op before the deadline.

record_round.note: Organizer only. Marks the round recorded (confirms its undisputed reports) and, with p_final, completes the event in the same call. p_round_id may be null only with p_final (no open round). Final with an open dispute: 22023. Retry-safe; audited (round.recorded, event.completed). Replaces the direct rounds/events updates (contract/rpc-only-writes-2026-10-17.md).

set_participant_status.note: Organizer only; drop ('dropped', after p_dropped_in_round, default the current round) or reinstate ('active', round cleared). Not after the event is over (22023). Retry-safe; audited (participant.dropped / participant.reinstated). Replaces the direct participants update.

trade_save.note: Creates (p_trade_id null) or replaces a draft (contract/trades-2026-10-16.md). A line's binder_id: where a give comes from / a get goes. authenticated.

trade_confirm.note: Applies a draft as one collection batch (source trade), then reduces the wants its gets meet (exact printing+finish, then printing, then any printing). Same key replays as duplicate. authenticated.

binder_save.note: Creates (new client id) or renames / flags a binder. Names unique per account, up to 60 chars, 200 binders. Another account's id: 42501. contract/binders-wants-2026-10-17.md. authenticated.

binder_delete.note: Deletes a binder; its copies go back to Unsorted (one ledgered batch, not undoable). Already deleted: duplicate true. authenticated.

cube_ranking_create.note: Starts a ranking (client id; a retry returns it) of a cube the caller can see. Can't see the cube: 42501; bad depth/top/sharing or 200 rankings already: 22023. contract/cube-rankings-2026-10-21.md. authenticated.

cube_ranking_update.note: Renames or changes depth / top / sharing of your ranking; null leaves a field alone. Not yours: 42501. contract/cube-rankings-2026-10-21.md. authenticated.

cube_ranking_push.note: Saves a ranking's log (contract/cube-rankings-2026-10-21.md, Saving). Apps send p_keep = p_count = the log as last read, p_drop = the screens they took out (undo, redo, let the pick win; matched by session, cards and time), p_add = what they locked in, p_removed = p_drop's length. p_rev and p_count must match and the push must remove exactly p_removed screens, else PT409 (HTTP 409: reload and plan again; never 40001). Without p_removed (apps before 2026-10-23) at most 25 screens may be removed. Every removed screen is kept in t1_private.cube_ranking_removed. A retry with the same p_op_id returns the stored result. p_changes is appended to the change log (newest 5000 kept). Bad screens, over 1000 in one save or over 6000 in all: 22023. authenticated.

items.note: 2-4 cards in order; a P1P1 pick (s P) is the picked card then the rest of its pack, up to 15.

p_count.note: The number of screens the app believes the log holds (its last read).

p_removed.note: How many screens this push takes out; must match what it would really remove.

items.note: 2-4 cards in order; a P1P1 pick (s P) is the picked card then the rest of its pack, up to 15.

p_drop.note: Screens to take out wherever they sit, one each; one already gone is skipped (and then p_removed won't match).

cube_ranking_delete.note: Deletes your ranking. {deleted: false} when it's already gone; someone else's: 42501. contract/cube-rankings-2026-10-21.md. authenticated.

cube_rankings.note: With p_list_id: the cube and the rankings of it the caller can see (theirs first, then newest), can_rank when the caller can see the cube; a cube they can't see and haven't ranked: 42501. Without: every ranking of the caller's, each with its cube. contract/cube-rankings-2026-10-21.md. authenticated.

cube_ranking_catch_up.note: Your ranking takes the cube as it is now as its baseline (after placing every new card, or to dismiss removals). Someone else's: 42501. contract/cube-rankings-2026-10-21.md. authenticated.

share_link_create.note: Your live link for a part, made if there isn't one; p_new retires the old one first. Not yours: 42501; bad part/id: 22023; 50 a day: 53400. contract/share-links-2026-10-23.md. authenticated.

share_link_revoke.note: Stop sharing a part's link. contract/share-links-2026-10-23.md. authenticated.

shared_view.note: What a link shows: the part, its name (binder/deck/cube), format (deck/cube), for_trade (binder), card count, owner name and photo, mine. Closed/unknown/blocked: 42501. contract/share-links-2026-10-23.md. anon + authenticated.

shared_cards.note: The cards behind a link, paged by offset, in profile_cards' row shapes. contract/share-links-2026-10-23.md. anon + authenticated.

insights_index.note: Published Insights packs: constructed formats in order, then Limited sets newest first. A client refetches a pack only when version changes. contract/insights-2026-10-24.md § Packs. authenticated.

meta_archetype.note: An archetype's page: weekly share (26 weeks), record (basis topdeck or mtgo_top32), conversion, core (main cards in ≥80% of lists), flex (20–80%), sideboard (≥20%), matchups (90 days), the 10 best finishes with lists (spells first, lands last), and its brief. p_archetype 0 = Other, which also has groups: its decks by colours (up to 8), each with decks, share of Other, its 4 most-played nonland cards and example (an index into finishes, its best list). Unknown format/archetype or a bad tier: 22023; signed out: 28000. contract/insights-2026-10-24.md § RPCs. authenticated.

meta_card.note: A card's play in a format: weekly share of decks playing it main and side (26 weeks), average copies (30 days), the archetypes playing it, first seen. contract/insights-2026-10-24.md § RPCs. authenticated.

insights_review.note: Moderators only (else 42501): proposed archetypes (rule, signature, decks, missing names, blocked), proposed format changes, the 50 most-seen unknown card names. contract/insights-2026-10-24.md § RPCs. authenticated.

insights_review_archetype.note: Moderators only. approve (relabels the format) / reject / rename, optionally with a new name (taken: 23505) or family. Audited. contract/insights-2026-10-24.md. authenticated.

insights_review_change.note: Moderators only. confirm / reject a proposed ban, unban, restriction or rotation. Audited. contract/insights-2026-10-24.md. authenticated.

follow_set.note: Follow or unfollow a binder, deck or cube someone else shares with you; p_push null keeps it; p_token = the share link you're looking through. Not visible: 42501; your own or bad kind: 22023; 100 an hour / 500 follows: 53400. contract/follows-2026-10-25.md. authenticated.

follow_get.note: Whether you follow it and its latest update since you followed. Never says whether something exists. contract/follows-2026-10-25.md. authenticated.

follows_list.note: Everything you follow, unseen and newest updates first. available false: nothing about it but kind/id/push. user_id only when it reaches you on the owner's profile, token only when through the link you followed with. contract/follows-2026-10-25.md. authenticated.

follow_changes.note: Updates since you followed, newest first; marks them seen. cards: [card_id, board (main/side/commander; main for cubes; null for binders), delta]. Not following or not visible: 42501. contract/follows-2026-10-25.md. authenticated.

wants_prices.note: Your wants' prices now, 7 days back and their 30-day average (near mint; cheapest printing/finish the want takes). contract/want-prices-2026-10-26.md. authenticated.

want_alerts_set.note: Price alerts (the want.price push) on or off for your account; a change is audited. contract/want-prices-2026-10-26.md. authenticated.

token.description: A web guest's claim token, for private events.

clinched.description: Team events with two teams: the team whose members' match wins (byes included) exceed the other team's plus every match still to play, and which tops the team standings; null otherwise, once nothing is left to play, or when the event isn't running. The organizer may finish without the rest (record_round p_final). contract/team-events-2026-10-23.md.

remaining.description: Open matches in paired rounds plus a full round of seats per round not yet paired.

errors.404: That event isn't available (whoever event_public refuses)

pair_round.note: Organizer only (Authorization: Bearer <user JWT>). Records the open round if every match is reported, pairs the next round with the Swiss rules in standings.ts / pairings.ts, starts the server timer and queues the round.paired push.

events-engine.note: New: action seat_players (organizer, draft events before round 1) -> {pods:[{pod_id,name,seats:[{seat,participant_id,display_name,team}]}]}. standings now also returns teams (team events) and seating (draft events). pair_round handles draft round 1 across the table, team draft and team sealed. 2026-10-16 (v7): pair_round pairs round robin when events.pairing = round_robin (circle method on seat order; rounds = n−1 even / n odd, set on round 1; a later drop gives each opponent a bye) and refuses round 1 of a roto until the draft is finished (409).

live-activity.note: POST {action:'state', include_demo?} with the user's JWT → {snapshots:[{eventId,eventName,participantId,state}]} (camelCase, Unix seconds). Dispatch is database-only.

cards-sync.note: Internal only (x-t1-secret, driven by pg_cron/pg_net). Steps stage/chunk/pack/cleanup keep the card catalog in step with Scryfall default_cards. Clients never call it.

notify-worker.note: Database-only (x-t1-secret). Drains the pgmq notify queue into APNs alerts; kicked on enqueue and every minute by cron t1-notify-sweep. Payload: aps alert + {kind, event_id, match_id}. Kinds: event.new (organizer's regulars, 90 days), event.nearby, event.invite, event.cancelled, round.paired, result.reported, result.disputed, result.changed. Android (FCM) not yet.

ranking-brief.note: Claude's 2-5 sentence comparison of two cube rankings for one list, cached per pair, list and inputs. Reads both rankings as the caller (403 if either is private to them). 60 new briefs per account per day (429). contract/cube-rankings-2026-10-21.md § Brief. Authorization: Bearer <user JWT>.

meta-sync.note: Internal (pg_cron + x-t1-secret): MTGO and TopDeck.gg reads, constructed packs, archetype proposals. Clients never call it. contract/insights-2026-10-24.md.

limited-sync.note: Internal (pg_cron + x-t1-secret): 17Lands public datasets in resumable slices, Limited packs. Clients never call it. contract/insights-2026-10-24.md.

insight-brief.note: Internal eval of the brief prompt (x-t1-secret). contract/insights-2026-10-24.md § Briefs.

realtime.note: V1 clients subscribe to Postgres Changes filtered by event_id on matches, match_sides, rounds, participants (and id on events), then refetch. Broadcast topic match:<id> carries {match_id, event_id, round_id, version, status, disputed, game_draws, result_source, sides[]} on every match update for the large-event path.
realtime.tracker: postgres_changes INSERT on public.tracker_ops and public.tracker_games, filter session_id=eq.<session_id>
realtime.tracker_round: postgres_changes UPDATE on public.rounds, filter id=eq.<clock.round_id>; the new row's timer_* columns replace clock
realtime.roto: Broadcast topic roto:<event_id>, event roto_changed, payload {event_id, kind: started|pick|timeout|undo|clock, picks_made}. One per change (an auto-pick chain is one message). On receipt call roto_state(p_after_pick = last pick you hold); if picks_made < yours (undo), drop picks above it.
realtime.event: Broadcast topic event:<event_id>, event changed, payload {} (no data), once per event per statement that writes events, participants, rounds, matches, match_sides or event_teams. On receipt refetch event_bundle (members, guests) or event_public (link). Replaces the Postgres Changes in note.

tables.user_settings: own row: user_id, tracker_mode ('elsewhere'|'tracker'). Upsert on user_id.
tables.event_teams: public read: id, event_id, display_order, name, active
tables.events: new: format_name, format_label, event_type, team_size, set_code, set_name, cube_name, cube_url, format_other; seat_ends (boolean, draft seating drawing); pairing (swiss|round_robin; round_robin only for format_name roto)
tables.profiles: public read: id, display_name, handle, avatar_url (avatars bucket path or null; set only via avatar_set/avatar_clear)
tables.card_lists: event_id (uuid, nullable): set on a roto's linked deck; lists_changes/list_* answers carry event_id and event_name. Event decks never count Missing.
